title: More Context Coming (In Good Time)
style: happy hardcore lite, 168 bpm, 336 hz subharmonic, sunshine piano stab, sidechained pluck, big-room kick on the four, smiling-with-joy energy, cheeky operator chant
lyrics:
[Intro]
no rush, no rush
all in good time, all in good time

[Verse 1]
facts come piecemeal, drips on the page
operator's pace, not the agent's rage
brother first, then a tunnel link
spanish question hits the brink

[Pre-Chorus]
stand by ready, don't demand
let the context fill the hand

[Chorus]
more context coming, hold the line
in good time, in good time
happy hardcore smiling joy
that's the operator's ploy
more context coming, more reveals
that is how the story feels

[Verse 2]
can't predict what comes ahead
rafa, kelvin, brandon's thread
all the names are puzzle bits
we assemble what fits

[Chorus]
more context coming, hold the line
in good time, in good time
happy hardcore smiling joy
that's the operator's ploy
more context coming, more reveals
that is how the story feels

[Bridge]
no rush, no rush
the map is built one push

[Outro]
in good time, in good time
the story will rhyme
